issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted 2026-08-12) decides on a third dependency kind `verifies` plus a structural diagnosis of inverted verification gates — a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead — reported advisory-only, never rejected at insert, and never inferred from titles. The ADR records 21 and 24 inverted edges in two live workspaces (a steady 4–6% of new beads), so the authoring error is real and recurring, and no open bead tracks the implementation. Close the gap by: extending the dependency model and the §3.4 edge set with `verifies`; extending `bead manifest`/`bead dep` and the checkpoint representation (schema, field guide, unknown-field-safe round trips); reporting inversions through doctor/policy lint in the same advisory posture as R021; exposing the declared relationship to R023's claim `why` explanation. Include cycle-interaction coverage (a two-node ring that is simultaneously a cycle and an inversion), concurrency tests for `verifies`-edge insertion per the engineering rule, and conformance fixtures.

issue.description:
Child in the replacement auto-split of beadrs-9cdb17cf (itself child 1 of 5 under beadrs-a6554831). An earlier 4-child chain for this same parent (beadrs-46ced453, beadrs-da4fae12, beadrs-57a448b2, beadrs-9ddc6f45) was closed evidence-free by the Phase 19.4 sweeper at 17:09:16Z and again at 17:16:41Z on 2026-09-05; those titles are immutable and start with the sweeper's attractor word, so these replacements carry resistant titles and put the commands in the body.

Context: the update-path credential fence is believed already landed in commit 7addba8 on origin/main. The deliverable is independent verification of this one slice against the landed code, or the smallest possible fix if a gap is found. Re-implementing from scratch is not wanted.

Scope: in update_issue_in_tx the credential validation, the UPDATE, and the audit event execute inside one begin_lifecycle_transaction opened with TransactionBehavior::Immediate, so a refused credential leaves no audit event and no write.

Acceptance:
- Cite the begin -> validate -> mutate -> commit ordering in src/service/lifecycle.rs, and show in the test run that a refused update publishes no event and bumps no revision.
- Close reason carries the evidence: test summary line, the commit SHA verified against, and fmt/clippy results if any source change was needed.
issue.title: Confirm the update-path credential check shares one IMMEDIATE transaction
